name: com.quick-event/event-planner
title: Quick Event
description: Plan events with AI: prefilled start links, draft event pages, module prices.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a professional event page with AI-generated landing page, registration form, email templates, and ticket categories. Returns a live URL where participants can immediately register. Events are created as 30-day drafts. Always give the user the returned claimUrl: opening it lets them save the event to a free account, edit and publish it, or book a demo with the Quick Event team. If you should not create anything on the user's behalf, call get_start_link instead.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the event. Include event name, purpose, target audience, schedule, and any relevant details.

date.description: Event start date and time in ISO 8601 format

endDate.description: Event end date and time in ISO 8601 format

language.description: Language for the generated event page content

websiteUrl.description: Company website URL for branding extraction

tools.name: get_start_link
tools.description: Build a link that opens Quick Event in the user's browser with the event description already filled in. Creates nothing and needs no account: the user reviews the drafted event step by step and only then saves it to a free account. Give the returned url to the user.

description.description: Event description as discussed with the user: name, purpose, audience, programme, number of guests, what is needed (registration, check-in, app). Max. 2000 characters; longer text is cut.

language.description: Interface language of the Quick Event page the link opens

tools.name: suggest_modules
tools.description: Recommend which Quick Event modules fit an event (event page, registration, invitations, check-in with badge printing, event app) with current net euro prices per event, and a link to book a demo. Read-only.

eventType.description: Kind of event, e.g. conference, workshop, party, gala, meeting, trade fair, festival, wedding

needs.description: What the organiser needs, e.g. registration, paid tickets, invitations, check-in, badge printing, agenda, networking, live polls
